title: Journey to Bali | A Family Getaway in Ubud & Kuta
highlights: Enjoy a journey through Bali’s lush heartlands and coastlines, where sacred temples, waterfalls, thrilling rides, and ocean views create unforgettable memories.
Snorkel in the turquoise waters of Crystal Bay, where vibrant coral gardens and tropical marine life create a serene underwater wonderland in the heart of Bali.
Upgrade your ride to a Volkswagen vintage car tour, blending retro charm with scenic island drives for an experience as unique as Bali itself.
Rejuvenate your body and soul at Bali’s handpicked spas, with exclusive discounts of up to 50% on therapies that combine age-old healing with modern comfort.
Snap memorable moments with a complimentary 1-hour photoshoot at Sari Timbul, where stunning backdrops and professional clicks turn your Bali trip into a lifelong memory.
overview:
About the Tour:
Embark on a vibrant journey through Bali, where each day blends adventure, culture, and natural beauty. Begin with a visit to Tegenungan Waterfall, then soar high above the jungle on the Bali Swing and explore the scenic Tegallalang Rice Terrace. Discover spiritual serenity at Tirta Empul Temple, known for its sacred spring. Dive into wildlife encounters at Taman Safari, and experience indoor thrills at Trans Studio Bali. Head to Nusa Penida to marvel at coastal wonders like Kelingking Beach, Angel’s Billabong, Broken Bay, and snorkel in the clear waters of Crystal Bay. Return to South Bali for water sports at Tanjung Benoa Beach, including parasailing, jet skiing, and banana boat rides. End your adventure at Uluwatu Temple, where a cliffside sunset and fiery Kecak Dance performance bring your journey to a magical close.

know_before_you_go: Visa on Arrival (VOA) for Indonesia is not included in your package and must be obtained and paid for at the airport upon your arrival. Please ensure you have the necessary documents ready.
Complimentary activities included in your package are provided as a value addition, but if any of these are missed for any reason, they cannot be refunded, exchanged, or compensated.

Where your itinerary mentions “local lunch,” it refers to an authentic Balinese meal featuring traditional flavors and dishes. Indian food will not be served during these local lunch experiences unless specifically mentioned.
Vehicles will follow a fixed point-to-point route as per the itinerary. Any changes or additional sightseeing requests may incur extra charges.
Bahasa Indonesia is the official language, and Balinese is also widely spoken. However, English is commonly understood in most tourist areas.
The local currency is the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR). While credit cards are accepted in many restaurants and hotels, cash is often preferred in smaller shops and markets.
When visiting temples or sacred sites, dress respectfully: cover your shoulders and knees, and wear a sarong and sash when required (often available at the entrance).

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Bali | Transfer to Ubud | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Bali! Upon arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport, get transferred to your hotel in Ubud. Post check-in, spend your time at leisure, where you can relax or explore the city on your own. You can head out and discover Goa Gajah, the ancient 'Elephant Cave' filled with historic carvings and spiritual charm. Also, you can visit Bali Bird Park to see a vibrant collection of exotic birds from around the world or enjoy fun rides at Waterbom Bali, a top-rated waterpark with thrilling slides & pools.

days.title: Taman Safari Experience at Bali Safari & Marine Park
days.desc: Begin today's day with a delicious floating breakfast at your hotel. After that, get driven to explore Central Bali. Unlimited Bali Swing, where you soar high above lush valleys. Next, visit Tegenungan Waterfall, a jungle gem perfect for scenic shots, followed by a stop at Tirta Empul Temple, known for its holy spring waters. Don't miss capturing your best moments with a free 1-hour photoshoot at Sari Timbul before concluding at Tegallalang Rice Terrace. Later, get driven back to the hotel.

days.title: Central Bali Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Enjoy a day of Bali’s most iconic experiences with a vintage Volkswagen car tour. Start with Bali Swing, where you soar high above lush valleys for thrilling views. Next, marvel at Tegenungan Waterfall, perfect for a peaceful escape, followed by a visit to Tirta Empul, a sacred water temple known for its holy springs. days.title: Nusa Penida West Tour | Balinese Massage Experience | Transfer to Kuta
days.desc: Check out & get driven to Sanur Port to take the speedboat to Nusa Penida Island. Upon arriving, marvel at T-Rex shaped viewpoint of Kelingking Beach, followed by the natural infinity pool at Angel’s Billabong & archway of Broken Bay. Also, relax at the shores of Crystal Bay & admire panoramic vistas from Paluang Cliff. After that, get transferred for a soothing Balinese massage session at a hand-picked spa, a perfect way to unwind. Later, get driven to Kuta. Upon arrival, check in at the hotel.

days.title: Visit to GWK Park  & Waterbom Bali
days.desc: Enjoy a perfect blend of culture & adventure with a visit to GWK Cultural Park & Waterbom Bali. Firstly, visit GWK Park, home to the iconic Garuda Wisnu Kencana statue, one of the tallest monuments in the world. While there, also marvel at the Balinese art & witness cultural performances. Later, visit Waterbom Bali, Asia’s leading waterpark, where heart-racing slides, kids’ play zones & tropical gardens create an ultimate experience for thrill-seekers. Later, get driven back to the hotel.

items.title: GWK Cultural Park Tour - GWK Park Admission Tickets

days.title: Water Sports at Tanjung Benoa Beach | Uluwatu Sunset Tour with Kecak Fire Show | Visit to Kuta Market
days.desc: Set out on a day full of adventure & fun. Begin with water sports, where activities like jet skiing, parasailing & banana boat rides promise an adrenaline rush. Afterwards, visit Melasti Beach, known for its dramatic limestone cliffs. Continue to the iconic Uluwatu Temple, perched on a cliff overlooking the ocean & witness the engaging Kecak Dance performance at sunset. End the day with a visit to the lively Kuta Market, perfect for shopping for souvenirs. Later, get driven back to the hotel.
